longForm.heroHook: A motorized stand positions the probe for you. Dial speed in hundreds of RPM, not thousands.
longForm.heroLead: Positioning a probe by hand gets harder the bigger the vessel gets, and getting exactly the right speed on a coarse dial is guesswork. PRO400DS fixes both. The PRO TRAC stand moves the motor into position for you, effortless, accurate, and smooth, with 14.5 inches of clearance for your container. A 1305W motor delivers real power, and a 3-turn speed knob adjusts RPM in fine hundreds rather than coarse thousands, read off a bright LED display with a dual-power light indicator that makes spotting an error simple. Volume range runs from 0.05mL up to 30L, and the entire ProScientific probe line mounts to this unit. The generator probe itself is sold separately, so confirm your probe alongside the base unit.

sections.title: Product Information
sections.description: PRO400DS digital benchtop homogenizer product information: motorized stand, digital speed control, and volume capacity.
body: PRO400DS pairs a 1305W motor with digital speed control, the most power in the ProScientific range so far, aimed at labs that need real throughput without sacrificing precision.

The PRO TRAC stand, a motorized stand developed specifically to handle motor positioning, moves the unit into place effortlessly, accurately, and smoothly rather than requiring manual adjustment for every sample.

Speed control gets genuinely finer here too. A 3-turn speed knob adjusts RPM in hundreds rather than thousands, and a bright LED display paired with a dual-power light indicator makes both setting the speed and spotting a problem straightforward.

Volume range runs from 0.05mL to 30L, covering everything from microliter-scale work to large vessel processing on the same unit, homogenizing, emulsifying, blending, and mixing both organic and inorganic materials.
The entire ProScientific probe line mounts to this unit, though the probe itself isn't included and needs to be selected and ordered separately.

sections.eyebrow: Motorized PRO TRAC Stand and Digital Speed Control
sections.title: Motorized PRO TRAC Stand and Digital Speed Control
sections.description: Manually positioning a probe over a large vessel is a real limiting factor once containers get bigger, and PRO TRAC removes that limitation directly. The stand moves the motor into place, effortlessly, accurately, and smoothly, rather than depending on how steady a hand you have. Speed control gets the same precision treatment. Coarse dials that jump in thousands of RPM make fine-tuning a specific condition difficult; the 3-turn knob here adjusts in hundreds instead, giving genuinely precise speed setting. The LED display keeps that setting visible at a glance, and the dual-power light indicator flags a problem before it turns into a failed run.

sections.eyebrow: Volume Range, Probe Selection, and Choosing Your Stand Length
sections.title: Volume Range, Probe Selection, and Choosing Your Stand Length
body: Volume range on PRO400DS runs wide, 0.05mL up to 30L, but the actual maximum for a given sample depends on viscosity as much as the unit's rated capacity.

Viscous samples reduce max capacity directly, and adding a Deflector Head to your generator probe helps by facilitating sample movement during homogenization, increasing the effective maximum volume you can process.

Since the probe isn't included, matching it to your vessel and sample type is a real configuration step, not an afterthought. And if your container needs more vertical clearance than the standard 14.5 inches provides, PRO400DSEL runs the same core unit with an Extra Length stand instead.

faqs.question: Does PRO400DSEL include a generator probe?

faqs.question: Can PRO400DSEL handle viscous samples?

faqs.question: What safety features does PRO400DSEL offer?
faqs.answer: It includes a Dual-Power Light Indicator for error identification, and can be fitted with the PRO SAFETY SEAL chamber assembly to contain aerosols and prevent cross-contamination.

faqs.question: Is PRO400DSEL compatible with all PRO probes?
faqs.answer: Yes, the entire line of PRO probes mounts to this unit, and it accepts the full range of PRO QUICK CONNECT generators.

sections.eyebrow: The Extra Length PRO TRAC Stand
sections.title: The Extra Length PRO TRAC Stand
sections.description: Some samples simply don't fit under a standard stand, and PRO400DSEL exists specifically for that situation. Where the standard PRO400DS offers 14.5 inches of total length, PRO400DSEL's Extra Length stand more than doubles that to 31 inches, purpose-built for taller containers and unique glassware like large-scale carboys. The stand itself stays motorized, so that added height doesn't come with added physical effort, positioning remains effortless, smooth, and accurate whether you're working at the top or bottom of that extended range. For labs whose vessel sizes vary, that extra clearance means one unit can cover both standard and larger-format processing without switching equipment.

cards.title: Clearance for taller containers or carboys
One unit covering varied vessel sizes

sections.title: Precision Control and Safety Features
body: Homogenization results depend on hitting a consistent RPM run after run, and staying alert to problems before they affect your sample or damage the motor.

The 3-turn speed knob adjusts RPM in increments of hundreds, rather than the coarser thousands-based adjustment found on simpler units, giving the finer control that sensitive emulsions specifically need. A bright LED display keeps that setting visible clearly throughout a run. The Dual-Power Light Indicator adds a layer of diagnostic feedback, flagging errors or problems immediately so downtime and motor overload risk both stay lower. Where aerosol containment matters, the PRO SAFETY SEAL chamber assembly fits directly onto the unit to keep aerosols contained and cross-contamination risk down.
